headline: AI Engineer · Frontend Architect
tagline: I ship AI applications that hold up in production.
subhead: A decade building production software — now focused on LLM applications, agentic workflows, and the interfaces that make them dependable for real teams.
proofLine: Led IVYGPT at Invesco — adopted by 8,000+ users; report analysis from ~30 days to ~30 minutes. Now building agentic AI platforms at ServiceNow.
bio: **I turn complex ideas into software that works — and AI into products people can trust.**
about:
I'm a Senior Software Engineer with a decade of experience building scalable products across frontend, full-stack systems, and AI. My foundation is in frontend architecture and product engineering; today, I apply that same production mindset to **LLM applications, agentic systems, and AI-powered experiences**.

I'm at my best when the problem isn't clearly defined, the solution doesn't exist yet, and someone needs to take ownership from **first idea to production**.

I bridge the gap between **interfaces, application architecture, and AI workflows** — combining engineering rigor, product thinking, and a bias toward building.

If you're building something ambitious with AI, **I'd love to hear about it.**
